info.cls_ename: FCU Pre-major Program for International Freshman Students
info.sub_ename: CRITICAL THINKING AND EXPRESSION IN CHINESE(2)

description.sub_ename: CRITICAL THINKING AND EXPRESSION IN CHINESE(2)
description.describe_ch: 本課程以溝通式教學法(Communicative Language Teaching)為主，聽說教學法(audiolingual method)為輔，提升國際生華語聽說讀寫基本能力，培養國際生在台灣求學與生活時，有效地應用華語進行溝通與表達。
description.describe_eh: This course is mainly based on Communicative Language Teaching, supplemented by audiolingual method, to improve the basic skills of international students in Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing, and to train them to effectively apply them when studying and living in Taiwan.

targets.describe_ch: 華語聽說讀寫的進階能力。
targets.describe_en: Advanced skills in Chinese listening, speaking, reading and writing.

targets.describe_ch: 華語溝通和表達的統合能力。
targets.describe_en: Integrated ability of Chinese communication and expression.

Students are requested to participate seriously. If there is no seriousness or cheating or plagiarism, the teacher will deduct the study marks
 
學術誠信是學習的基石，學生必須明白，合理使用AI工具可以輔助學習，但絕不能取代自己的思考與努力。AI能提供資訊和建議，但最終的理解和應用仍需依賴自身的學習過程。保持學術誠信不僅能提升個人能力，還能培養正確的價值觀，為未來的學術與職業生涯打下堅實的基礎。讓我們共同努力，善用科技，促進真正的學習與成長。
Academic integrity is the foundation of learning. Students must understand that using AI tools can help with learning, but they should not replace their own thinking and effort. AI can provide information and suggestions, but true understanding and application still rely on personal learning. Maintaining academic integrity not only enhances individual skills but also fosters the right values, laying a solid foundation for future academic and career success. Let’s work together to use technology wisely and promote genuine learning and growth.
